items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Armstrong? No, I don't think the play, he might come in to see his family.

ctx.x: I don't believe he's never coming back here anymore.
Armstrong? No, I don't think the play, he might come in to see his family.

He been away for a good while, too. I believe he left here before Ed Atkin left. Went to Chicago. A lot of guys went to Chicago. But all the towns I traveled, I liked New York better than I grew. Any of them towns I've been in. I liked New York.
